mostWorthwhile.text: Adding bone cells and then vessels connected the hard matrix to living cells: the planned cutaways show channels linking cells and nutrients reaching them from blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: The capsule step was useful but left “synovial” unexplained, and the sequence of single offered combinations made the joint assembly fairly predictable.

surprise.text: The lineage picture changed my understanding by showing some matrix-producing osteoblasts becoming embedded osteocytes with processes in small channels. The terms themselves could use clearer explanation.

arbitrary.text: No action lacked a clear purpose, though most were the only offered combination rather than meaningful choices.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: the connections between material properties, living bone and joint movement were interesting, despite the predictable choices.
